title: The Stop hook's unpushed-commits nudge skips a branch whose head is already on origin/main
why: Lane artifact-pages-other-account (session_013NEJL49cWWQx8kXJAVpNoi), 04:38 CST Nov 9: after #2360 merged and runner 8 deleted the branch, the local branch had fast-forwarded to main. Stop hook command 9 counted 502 unpushed commits, all main's, and told the lane to push. The push recreated `artifact-pages-other-account` on origin as a plain copy of main (triage read: tip 81a720c42, an ancestor of origin/main). A nudge that recreates a deleted branch undoes the cleanup.
note: Fix proposed by the lane: skip a branch whose head is already on origin/main. The stray branch is on step branch-cleanup's delete list. Filed 04:39 CST Nov 9. Lane session_013NEJKz3J95T7tJBtSYUXZ9 started 12:13 CST Nov 9 (coordinator). Blocked on page item 464 (stop-hook-merged-branch, 12:20 CST Nov 9): may hooks/session_start.sh patch the platform's Stop-hook script, against the recorded call in decision lanes-start-in-tool-worktrees? Incident: the script counts main's own commits as unpushed when origin/HEAD is stale, and a lane recreated a merged branch with 502 commits. Meanwhile the lane stays idle and the coordinator's briefs carry option a (fetch, then git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD must be 0 before ending). Owner pick on the waiting page (13:09 CST Nov 9): item 464 b. session_start.sh adds a one-line skip after the platform writes its Stop-hook script, and a test goes red when the platform's script text changes. The owner chose it although it carries the label "Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo", so the pick is the owner's word for this act only.
